facts.fact: 篝火会 Lydia 跳进怀里喊 my friend，称靠她的魔法才熬住不睡
facts.anchor: “My friend!” An excited squeal caught Andra’s attention just before a small child jumped into her lap.

facts.fact: Lydia 问 Lucas 是谁，Andra 介绍表亲关系；Lucas 吻 Lydia 手背
Lucas 父亲自报家门 Fergal——父子/叔侄关系首次确立
facts.anchor: “I’m Fergal”—her uncle placed a hand on his chest—“and I have the privilege of sharing an important story with you tonight.

facts.fact: 纪念日由来：一百年前击败黑暗的光女巫（a century）
facts.anchor: The story of the light witch that defeated the darkness a century ago.

facts.fact: 故事主角 Edgeron：本就强大能操纵阴影黑暗却贪求更多；光暗大战后一位光女巫独自站出
facts.anchor: His name was Edgeron. He was incredibly powerful to begin with, containing the ability to control shadows and darkness.

facts.fact: 讲古时她脑中浮现不属于她的异象（世代相传画面）——能力首次展现；村猫 Gaya 跳上膝头
facts.anchor: Andra gasped as unfamiliar images floated through her mind. They were not her memories

facts.fact: 黑袍人压低兜帽露胡茬下颌与狞笑后没入树中；她追进树林
facts.anchor: He lowered his hood just enough to reveal a strong jaw dusted with stubble and a wicked grin, and swiftly he disappeared into the trees.

facts.fact: "Careful, love"+要她跑+狞笑低语 Run；倒数 Five-Four-Three-Two-One 追捕

facts.fact: 倒数结束从头顶树枝落下扣腰拉回胸前——"That was far too easy"

facts.fact: 自述大陆最好猎人，受命来此区处理某物："村里有个东西，我要它"
facts.anchor: I’m the best hunter on this continent, and I’ve been requested to deal with something within this region.

facts.fact: 她反驳领地内近二十年（two decades）没怪物、防御队有保障
facts.anchor: A monster hasn’t been sighted in our territory for nearly two decades. Our defensive teams have ensured that.

facts.fact: 章末：吻手背道别 Stay safe 后消失；余烬与皮革气味是唯一凭证
